summary: Shimmick Corp filed an 8-K to disclose an underwritten public offering of 4,289,500 shares of common stock at $3.50 per share, raising net proceeds of approximately $14.0 million. The offering was conducted under an existing shelf registration statement and closed on May 26, 2026. Roth Capital Partners acted as underwriter. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation, as it does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, restructuring, or similar event. The filing is an ordinary shelf takedown with no unusual terms or structural features that would categorize it as a special situation.
